ota.summary: Safety and smaller fixes from the code review: the bridge refuses requests from other websites; a damaged rescue firmware slot is reported; °C/°F no longer flips once after a restart; home apps show the unit's real setpoint; Matter no longer slows the bridge while pairing or gives up its start on a brief memory dip; room sensors use less processing; display Resync reads the unit and fixes it; Active clean's Stop survives a restart; setup page scans tidied; old code cleaned up.
